What does it cost to install carpet in Duvall, WA?

Figure $4 to $7 per square foot installed in Duvall, covering carpet, pad, labor, new tack strip and haul-away. Most complete projects fall between $2,000 and $4,500, while a 1,200 sq ft main floor with a staircase generally runs $5,500 to $8,500. The grade of carpet swings the total more than any other choice — and you make that choice with samples lying on your own floor.
Is there a mobile carpet showroom serving Duvall?

Yes — Duvall is regular territory for the showroom van. We arrive with 20+ carpet samples and all three pad grades, lay them in the rooms being recarpeted so the color reads true in your actual light, then measure every room and stair and leave a written price that same visit. There's no showroom to drive to, and the appointment costs nothing.
What does carpet stretching cost in Duvall?

Carpet stretching starts at $99 per room in Duvall. A power stretcher pulls out the ripples, waves and buckles that show up in hallways and family rooms, at roughly a fifth of what replacement costs. When the pile still stands and the color still works in the room, stretching is usually the smarter money.
What does it cost to carpet stairs in Duvall?

Stairs start at $18 per step, done either waterfall or cap-and-band. Landings and pie-shaped winders are measured and written into the quote from the start, so the stair figure you approve is exactly what you pay — nothing gets tacked on after the fact.
How long does a carpet install take?

One working day covers most Duvall installs. A typical uphill two-story — three or four bedrooms plus the staircase — is a standard day for our crew. A large house with stairs and heavy furniture throughout can carry into a second day, and the timeline is spelled out on your written quote.
Do you move furniture, or do I clear the rooms?

We move it. Beds, dressers, couches and tables are included on most jobs, and the crew sets everything back where it started. Your part is the small stuff — empty the closets and pack up electronics, breakables and anything you'd rather carry yourself.
Is my carpet worth restretching, or is it time to replace?

Restretch when the pile stands up, the backing is still sound and the color still earns its keep — that's a $99-per-room fix instead of buying new. Replace when traffic paths are crushed flat, seams are opening, the backing is coming apart, or pet odor has survived a professional cleaning. We tell you which situation you have before writing any quote.

A bit beyond that? Ask when you book — the van travels.
What's the best carpet for a house with dogs?

For homes with dogs — which around Duvall is a lot of them — solution-dyed nylon with a sealed backing over a moisture-barrier pad is the setup. The barrier stops accidents from reaching the subfloor, which is what makes odor permanent, and solution-dyed fiber takes a diluted-bleach cleanup without losing color. The pad upgrade starts at $0.65 per square foot.
What warranty do I get on the install?

OC Flooring covers the workmanship with a 1-year warranty, and the carpet carries its own mill warranty — usually 10 to 25 years on wear and stain depending on grade. Both appear on your written quote. Because pad choice can affect the mill's coverage, all three pad grades come along on the visit so you can pick one that keeps it valid.
